name: Ball Toss in Stable Stance

instructions.description: Stand upright with your feet about hip-width apart or slightly wider, knees softly bent, and core gently engaged. Hold a soft ball in both hands.
Gently toss the ball from one hand to the other, or toss it back and forth with a partner. Keep the throws light and controlled.
Follow the ball with your eyes as you catch and release it. Keep your feet planted and maintain a stable, upright posture.
Continue for the desired duration. If you feel less stable, pause, regain your balance, and widen your stance slightly before continuing.

variations.variationDescription: Ball Toss in Stable Stance — Wider-Base Balance Version: Increase the base of support to reduce balance demand.

commentsNotes: Use a soft ball and an uncluttered area.
Start with a wider stance for greater stability and narrow it gradually if comfortable.
Prioritize safe, controlled movement over speed.
